limitations.value: Axial-mode helical antennas are not supported by the installed antenna recipes. Currently supported antenna families are rectangular inset-fed patch (inset_patch_v2), probe-fed circular patch (circular_patch_v1), and center-fed dipole (dipole_v1).

value.request: Create an axial-mode helical antenna with eight turns at 1.6 GHz.
value.response: Axial-mode helical antennas are not supported by the installed antenna recipes. Currently supported antenna families are rectangular inset-fed patch (inset_patch_v2), probe-fed circular patch (circular_patch_v1), and center-fed dipole (dipole_v1).
